WhatIsManpower.title: What Is International Manpower Supply?
WhatIsManpower.subtitle: It is the process of sourcing qualified workers in one country and deploying them to employers in another — legally, safely, and with full documentation support from start to finish.
WhatIsManpower.description1: Future Focus Company manages the complete manpower supply chain from Bangladesh to Saudi Arabia. We identify workers who match your exact role requirements, conduct thorough screening and medical tests, process visas and travel documentation, and coordinate deployment to your worksite—so you receive work-ready professionals, not paperwork headaches.
WhatIsManpower.description2: Our manpower supply service covers three major worker categories: skilled professionals (welders, electricians, plumbers), semi-skilled workers (kitchen helpers, factory assistants, baristas), and unskilled labor (general cleaners, site laborers, garden workers). Every worker goes through strict recruitment, verification, and pre-deployment training.

WhatIsManpower.quote: We are a government-approved manpower supply company connecting Bangladesh's workforce with employers across Saudi Arabia through ethical recruitment, complete documentation, and reliable deployment.

FAQ.title: Before You Contact Us
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to the questions we receive most often — so you know exactly what to expect.

items.question: How quickly do you respond to enquiries?
items.answer: Our team usually responds within 2–3 business hours during Saudi office hours. WhatsApp inquiries receive the fastest response.

items.question: How long does it take to deploy workers?
items.answer: Deployment generally takes 15–30 days depending on visa approval, documentation, and the required profession.

items.question: What information should I include in my enquiry?
items.answer: Please mention the job category, number of workers required, project location, expected joining date, and your contact information.

items.question: Can I visit your Riyadh office?
items.answer: Yes. We welcome employers to visit our Riyadh office by appointment during business hours.

items.question: Is there a minimum order for manpower supply?
items.answer: No. We can provide a single worker or hundreds of workers depending on your business requirements.

items.question: Which industries do you supply workers for?
items.answer: We provide manpower for construction, hospitality, cleaning, logistics, security, healthcare, factories, supermarkets, offices, restaurants and many more.

FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subheading: Everything you need to know about our recruitment process, visa compliance, worker deployment, and service guarantees in Dubai & Saudi Arabia.
FAQ.stillHaveQuestions: Have a specific workforce requirement not answered here?

item1.question: How quickly can Future Focus deploy workers to our Dubai project?
item1.answer: Standard deployment takes between 14 to 21 days from visa quota approval. For pre-vetted candidates already in our talent pipeline, mobilization can occur in as few as 7 business days.

item2.question: Are all supplied candidates trade-tested and medical-checked?
item2.answer: Yes. Every candidate undergoes rigorous practical trade testing at certified centers in Bangladesh, followed by GAMCA medical screening, background checks, and embassy document attestation before arrival.

item3.question: What happens if a deployed worker does not meet our performance standards?
item3.answer: We offer a 90-day performance and medical guarantee. If any candidate fails to meet your agreed skill level or medical compliance during this window, we replace them at zero extra recruitment fee.

item4.question: Which industries and manpower categories do you specialize in?
item4.answer: We specialize in Construction & Civil Engineering, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing), Hospitality & Catering, Facility Management, Logistics, Security Services, and Heavy Equipment Operation.

item5.question: Do you handle visa processing, flights, and government clearance?
item5.answer: Yes, we manage end-to-end mobilization including MOHRE work permits, employment visa processing, flight bookings, pre-departure orientation, and airport reception upon arrival in the UAE/KSA.
